danny.audio_profile: Danny, a regular guy in his late thirties. He is genuinely a little scared and still shaken, and he tells what happened plainly and honestly, in a natural voice with very little inflection, keeping his pitch fairly level and even, like a real person, not an actor.

theo.audio_profile: Theo, fifteen. A skinny teenage boy with a light, young voice that has only just started to break. He has lived alone in a mall's ceiling for four months: guarded, quick and a little defiant, and he talks in short sentences. A real teenager, not an actor.

vera.audio_profile: Vera, a woman in her forties. Calm, warm and funny, and she never raises her voice. She sounds friendly and in control, which is what makes her frightening.

scene: A man quietly tells what happened during the first days of a zombie outbreak at the mall where he works. Close to the microphone, plain and natural, no music.
sample_context: A first-person story told plainly, in a natural, slightly scared voice.

chunks.text: Right now my leg is hanging through the ceiling over a hundred dead people, and my best friend is walking right under it.
The edge of the hole is cutting into my thigh. My boot is caught on something sharp. Every time I move, a little more white dust falls past my foot.

lines.text: A piece the size of my thumbnail lands on the fountain rim.
In a mall this quiet, that's a dinner bell.

I closed my fist around the tag.

chunks.scene: In a dark, locked store in a mall full of the dead, a runaway teenager talks quietly with the night guard.
chunks.text: They weren't trying to rob a store. They were trying to get underneath it.
I thought of old Walt tapping the last key. That one, you never use. Don't ask.
Across the highway was my daughter. Across the roof was a woman copying her signal.
And the one thing that woman wanted was hanging from my belt.
What did she think was behind that door?
